Officer's narrative
The collision occurred in a parking lot in Pearland, Texas. Driver 1 reported neck and lower back strain and was
seated in the driver's position of the vehicle when I arrived. The Passenger's account and my own observations
confirm that Driver 1 was inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Driver 2 was backing out of a space and struck the
rear quarter panel of Driver 1's vehicle at low speed.
Damage to the rear of Driver 1's vehicle is largely consistent with the impact described by both drivers. A few older
scratches are visible on the bumper, and these may predate this collision. Photographs taken at the scene confirm
the lcoation and general extent of the contact, but no independent witnesses were identified. The reported injuries
appear consistent with the type and force of this collision.
Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the policy covering the vehicle. No citations were issued at the scene. Both
drivers were advised of their reporting obligations, and the Passenger declined medical assistance at the scene.
